attributes.name: intro_text_alignment_and_width
attributes.definition: How the introductory or section-opening text is aligned and constrained in width.

values.definition: Intro text and/or headings are centered within a narrow measure.
Intro text is left-aligned in a standard or wide column.

attributes.name: intro_section_column_structure
attributes.definition: How the intro/about section is divided into columns or blocks.

values.definition: Intro content sits in one column.
Intro text or heading and body are split into two side-by-side text columns.
Section pairs a coloured block or media with a text column, alternating sides down the page.
